headline: Jahmyr Gibbs scores three touchdowns, and Kyra's job was just showing up.
dek: Marlee's also perfect at 3-0. Cambri lost by 3.46, the closest game of the week, and has nothing to show for it. Samantha got real bad news on De'Von Achane, and Maddie is 0-3.

matchups.6-7: Kyra scored a league-best 170.48 this week, behind three touchdowns from Jahmyr Gibbs. Samantha's night was worse than the score: De'Von Achane left with a torn ACL and is done for the season. Get well soon, De'Von.
matchups.5-8: Maya edged Cambri by 3.46, the tightest game of the week. Bijan Robinson did it almost alone: 194 yards, two touchdowns. Justin Jefferson managed just 5.2 points for Cambri.
matchups.1-4: Marlee stayed perfect at 3-0, beating Tara by 23.22. Tara was projected for 138.53 and scored 110.32, a 28-point gap projections don't usually miss by. Quinshon Judkins started in the flex, the lineup's wildcard spot, and managed 9.9.
matchups.2-3: Amie improved to 2-1 with a blowout, winning by 50.76. Her Patrick Mahomes waiver pickup scored 15.94 points in his very first week, a debut most managers wait months for. Maddie is 0-3. Jonathan Taylor was projected for 20.62 and scored 9.2.

game_balls.title: The best game anyone had this week
game_balls.text: Gibbs scored 41.4 points, the best single game in the league this week. Kyra's entire job was starting him. She nailed it.

game_balls.title: Andrews is settling in just fine
game_balls.text: Marlee started George Kittle over Mark Andrews. Kittle scored 26.2 and two touchdowns. Andrews managed 5.4, proof he's settling in just fine on the bench.

game_balls.title: Freshly claimed, immediately trusted
game_balls.text: Amie claimed Patrick Mahomes off waivers and started him the same week. He threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns. Most waiver claims take longer than one game to pay off this well.

game_balls.title: One good pickup in a rough week
game_balls.text: Cambri picked up Jordan Love as a free agent. He threw for 312 yards and two touchdowns for 18.48 points in his first game on her roster. Her week went the other way.

flags.title: The worst bench call in the league
flags.text: Maya started Dalton Schultz over Brock Bowers. Bowers scored 27.6 from the bench. Schultz scored 6. The worst bench call in the league this week, and she still won.

flags.title: Christian Watson, still undefeated on the bench
flags.text: Tara benched Christian Watson for Quinshon Judkins in the flex spot. Judkins managed 9.9. Christian Watson scored 22.6 from her bench. Again.

flags.title: 23.22 to spare
flags.text: Marlee started Ladd McConkey over Michael Wilson. McConkey scored 10.6 while Wilson racked up 25.9 on the bench, a gap that would sink most 3-0 teams. Marlee's isn't most teams.

flags.title: The Waddle bet stops paying off
flags.text: Two weeks ago, starting Jaylen Waddle over DK Metcalf was Maddie's Week 2 game ball. This week, Waddle managed 6.4 while Metcalf put up 12.1 from the bench. Loyalty stopped paying.

tough_breaks.title: Achane's season is over
tough_breaks.text: De'Von Achane tore his ACL against the Chiefs and is out for the year. He had 3 carries for 17 yards before he left the game. Get well soon, De'Von.

tough_breaks.title: Playing hurt, and it cost her
tough_breaks.text: Justin Jefferson played through a bad ankle and managed two catches for 5.2 points. Cambri lost by 3.46, close enough to wonder what a healthy Jefferson would have done.

glossary.definition: The player who takes handoffs and runs the ball (and often catches passes too), like this week's headliners Jahmyr Gibbs and Bijan Robinson.
The pool of unrostered players; when someone breaks out or gets dropped, managers submit claims and the winner gets him a few days later, like Amie did with Patrick Mahomes this week.
A player who scores way under what was expected, like Jonathan Taylor's 9.2 points on a 20.62 projection this week.
Your one defensive roster spot, scored as a team for sacks and turnovers and docked for whatever the other team scores, which is how Tara's went negative this week.
